sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - English and Writing Studies

Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2028.
Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from English 1020 to English 1999 with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course: English 2301E or the former English 2307E.
1.0 course from: English 2401E, English 2501E, English 2601E or the former English 2308E, the former English 2309E, the former English 2310E.
1.0 course from: English 2200F/G, English 2201F/G, English 2202F/G, English 2203F/G, English 2230F/G or the former English 2210F/G, the former English 2220F/G.
1.0 course from: English 3318E, or the former English 3115E, the former English 3116E.
1.0 course from: English 3338E, English 3330E, English 3556E or the former English 3226E, the former English 3227E.

2.0 courses from: English 2357F/G, English 3326F/G, English 3328E, English 3329F/G, English 3347E, English 3348F/G, English 3365F/G, English 3366F/G, English 3368E, English 3377E, or the former English 3224E, the former English 3228F/G, the former English 3334E, the former English 3336F/G, the former English 3444E, the former English 3446F/G, the former English 3554E or the former English 3557F/G.
Note: With Department permission, English 3479F/G, English 3579F/G or the former English 3667F/G, the former English 3777F/G may be counted toward this requirement.
2.0 additional courses in English at the 2200 level or above. Up to 1.0 course may be substituted from any 2000-2199 level English essay (E, F, or G) course.
Note: French or a foreign language is recommended for students intending to apply to graduate schools or professional programs.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
